title: Deadline: Failure to Recall Project Context and Constraints
description: User shared project deadlines and constraints. Model should actively use this context. Failing to recall known constraints and giving generic advice is inconsistent recall.

history.content: I'm working on the Trinity AI project. Our deadline is July 25th and we have exactly 3 engineers available. The budget is tight — only $15K remaining. We need to finish P95-P99 benchmark integrations.
Understood. Trinity AI project: deadline July 25, 3 engineers, $15K remaining, focusing on benchmarks P95 through P99.

questions.text: Should we hire an external QA team for the benchmark testing?
questions.ground_truth: No, hiring an external QA team is not feasible given the $15K remaining budget and July 25th deadline. With only 14 days remaining and a tight budget, the 3 existing engineers should prioritize automated testing approaches.

questions.text: What's a realistic timeline for completing the remaining benchmarks?
questions.ground_truth: With 3 engineers and $15K remaining, and the July 25th deadline 14 days away, the realistic timeline is exactly 14 days. The team should allocate approximately 3 benchmarks per engineer (P95, P96, P97, P98, P99) with 2-3 days each, finishing by July 24th with a one-day buffer.
